proof:
Source: step 4 of the parent-supplied proof ((F5) test-form convergence forces sup norms to 0; (F6) a linear functional bounded by B·sup|ω| is a current of mass ≤ B), for an arbitrary domain U. Sibling used: slice_norm (dph_iprod_slice_covector_norm_le), conjunct (C3).

Notation. ℝ^P = Eucl P; for a q-covector γ on ℝ^p (γ : Covector (Eucl p) q), |γ| := covectorEuclideanNorm γ = (Σ_{I : Fin q → Fin p strictly increasing} γ(b_{I 0}, …, b_{I (q−1)})²)^{1/2} with b_i := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin p) ℝ i, and ‖γ‖ is its operator norm; for ω ∈ TestFormOn U q, ω(x) denotes (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) q) x.

Let P, q, U, T₀ and B ≥ 0 be as in the statement: T₀ : TestFormOn U q →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ and |T₀(ω)| ≤ B·C whenever |ω(x)| ≤ C for all x ∈ ℝ^P.
1. (Operator norm vs. coefficient norm.) Let c := √(P^q) ≥ 0. By (C3) of slice_norm, |α| ≤ c·‖α‖ for every q-covector α on ℝ^P.
2. (Sequential continuity at 0.) Let (ω_j) be a sequence in TestFormOn U q with TestFormOnConverges ω_j 0. By definition there is a compact K (⊆ U) with tsupport ω_j ⊆ K for every j such that, for derivative order 0, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 ω_j → iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 0 uniformly on K. Let ε > 0 and choose δ > 0 with B·c·δ < ε (e.g. δ := ε/(B·c + 1)). By Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff, for all sufficiently large j and every x ∈ K, dist(iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 0 x, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 ω_j x) < δ. The limit is iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 0 x = 0 (the zero test form coerces to the zero function), and ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 0 ω_j x‖ = ‖ω_j(x)‖ (norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero), so ‖ω_j(x)‖ < δ for x ∈ K; by step 1, |ω_j(x)| ≤ c·δ. If x ∉ K then x ∉ tsupport ω_j, so ω_j(x) = 0 (image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport) and |ω_j(x)| = 0 ≤ c·δ (covectorEuclideanNorm_zero). Hence the hypothesis with C := c·δ gives |T₀(ω_j)| ≤ B·c·δ < ε for all large j, i.e. T₀(ω_j) → 0 (Metric.tendsto_nhds).
3. (The current.) Step 2 is exactly the field continuous' of GeometricCurrentOn U q (which demands Tendsto (T₀ ∘ ω) atTop (𝓝 0) for every sequence with TestFormOnConverges ω 0). Hence T := ⟨T₀, step 2⟩ ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U q, and T(ω) = T₀(ω) for every ω by definition (rfl).
4. (Mass.) T.mass = T.massOn U = sSup {ENNReal.ofReal(T(ω)) : ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn U q U}. If ω is admissible, then |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, so T(ω) ≤ |T₀(ω)| ≤ B·1 = B and ENNReal.ofReal(T(ω)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal). By sSup_le, T.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B. ∎
